title: cynanchum eggersii
intro: Cynanchum eggersii, commonly known as the Island Bittersweet or Eggers' Twining Milkweed, is a plant species native to the Hawaiian Islands. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and treat respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchum eggersii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to ease congestion and promote the removal of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
